ABS Outstanding : It was reported by the Owner that the vessel’s Valve Control System was in malfunctioned condition.
The malfunctioned deficiency has been reported to Panama Maritime Authority and Panama Maritime Authority has authorized the vessel to sail with the malfunctioning / deficiencies on 18 August 2026.

The following documents were reviewed at this time.
- The confirmation of delivery schedule for new parts
- Risk assessment for malfunctioned Valve Control System 
The Owner and the vessel's Master were advised that the following conditions are to be followed per the authorization letter.
(a). To comply with port local regulations.
(b). The vessel's Master shall implement a risk assessment until the due date of this authorization.
The company's responsibility is to ensure that the vessel is maintained in conformity with the mandatory regulations.  This includes taking care of the items concerning the shipboard operation as per the ISM code and other items such as the safety of the crewmembers, vessel integrity, and environmental protection.  This is crucial for the crew's safety and the vessel's integrity.
This authorization shall not be considered a "release authorization" in case of a PSC detention.  The Owner and the vessel's Master should liaise directly with PSC authorities in such a case.
The Conditional Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate was issued and valid until 14 November 2026 per the authorization letter.
Cert - Cargo Ship Safety Construction CertificateECC

:

ABS Record Only Comment : Engine Power Limitation (EPL) approved, limiting the main engine’s power and speed to 18860 kW and 83.7 rpm.

ABS Record Only Comment : As reported by the Owner's Representative, the vessel's side shell starboard in way of Rope Store (S) was deformed during tug escort at Qingdao Port dated 07 AUG 2024.
The affected area (300 mm (W) x 150 mm (H)) was examined externally/ internally and reported as below:

- 
Shell Plating: A smooth plating indent from A.P. to Fr. 05, between Steering Gear Flat and SL-3 was found with a maximum depth of approximately 50 mm.

- 
Internals: Bent smoothly/slightly, and flanges were still relatively effective. 

This finding was addressed as a Record Only Comment.
